verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents user-defined, event-driven automation in two places. Custom Auto Labels let users write their own AI prompts, and incoming emails are labeled the moment they arrive. The whats-new page also mentions a visual builder for agents that run proactively on triggers you set. However, the documented rule actions are mostly labeling and inbox splitting, and it is unclear whether the agent builder belongs to Mail specifically. missing for 10: a documented range of rule actions beyond labeling (e.g., archive, forward, or reply per custom rule), detailed docs on configuring triggers and conditions in the agent builder, clarity that the agent builder applies to Superhuman Mail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can even make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts like "job applications" or "requests to review work".
Emails are labeled the moment they arrive, so you can see what's important and what's not.
Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
Custom Auto Labels let you categorize emails with your own AI prompts. (Available for our Business and Enterprise customers.)
